d: Imagine waking up to discover that $6.3 billion has vanished from the world's largest cryptocurrency exchange. That's what happened to Binance in what is being described as the biggest crypto heist in history. And the hackers may not have broken into the digital vault. They allegedly compromised the system that authorises transactions. But can the stolen billions ever be recovered? And what does this attack reveal about the security of the crypto industry? Palki Sharma tells you.
